means: Constructed replays, one per drawn node of shiwehi.com's stick spin (SDパフェ) route page: our own piece queue and key inputs, run from an empty board through the vendored Triangle engine, ending on the page's drawn board. Not a game anyone played and not corpus data.
not_eligible_because: not a game anyone played; not corpus data
one engine, no second implementation of the boards

caveat.order: Where the page does not fix the piece order, the order here is ours: the first piece of each of the page's before-pairs first (bag 1: O before Z and J before L, the page's no-hold conditions for the left pattern), then IOTSZJL, the T into the U slot last. order_reading records it per bag.
caveat.hold: No demo holds: the page's bag 1 is built without hold under its stated conditions, and nothing later is drawn held.
caveat.chain: Bag 2 hangs under the page's after-the-TSS illustrations and the PC patterns under its after-the-TSD ones; their demos run through the demo that ends on that board (bag1.fire, bag1.pc, 2.sd, 2.mochi). The fallback boards (TST, Imperial Cross, STMB Cave) are drawn with the slot empty and the T on a separate board; the demo fires it there.
caveat.spin: Every T-spin kind and line count is the engine's verdict on the replayed inputs.
